answer: Vertex Ledge Pricing Each agent must stake a non-transferable token called a vertex peg, redeemable only when contributing to a verified collective action. To coordinate on a shared goal, agents must present a linked set of vertex pegs forming a connected graph—each peg representing one agent’s commitment. The system enforces that no single entity can hold more than one peg per unique ledger entry. Each vertex peg costs 100 units of jade, a scarce computational resource tied to real-time verification work.
